# Demo: Ownership Boundaries and Port Conflicts

Verifies 'never kill what you do not own': Unmanaged IDE Service reuse on start, stop sparing Unmanaged processes, port Conflict fail-fast with inspect diagnostics, and Unmanaged Gateway reuse.

## Step 1: procomp discovers an Unmanaged IDE Process and reuses it on start

```console
$ procomp start pricing
pricing: reused UNMANAGED (IDE) [PID 10000, HEALTHY]
  note: route remains REMOTE (run 'procomp route pricing local' to route locally)
Summary: 0 started, 1 reused.

$ procomp status
Project: procomp-e2e
SERVICE        ROUTE   OWNER            HEALTH   BUILD       PORT   PID    UPTIME  STALE
broker         REMOTE  NONE             STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  16161  -      -       no
orders         REMOTE  NONE             STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  18101  -      -       no
pricing        REMOTE  UNMANAGED (IDE)  HEALTHY  NO_BUILDER  18102  10000  5s      no
notifications  REMOTE  NONE             STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  18103  -      -       no
Gateway: port 18080, NONE, STOPPED, OFFLINE
```

## Step 2: procomp stop spares Unmanaged Processes (never kill what you do not own)

```console
$ procomp stop pricing
pricing: spared Unmanaged (IDE) Process (PID 10000)
Summary: 0 stopped, 1 Unmanaged spared.

$ procomp status
Project: procomp-e2e
SERVICE        ROUTE   OWNER            HEALTH   BUILD       PORT   PID    UPTIME  STALE
broker         REMOTE  NONE             STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  16161  -      -       no
orders         REMOTE  NONE             STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  18101  -      -       no
pricing        REMOTE  UNMANAGED (IDE)  HEALTHY  NO_BUILDER  18102  10000  10s     no
notifications  REMOTE  NONE             STOPPED  NO_BUILDER  18103  -      -       no
Gateway: port 18080, NONE, STOPPED, OFFLINE
```

## Step 3: A foreign port Conflict fails fast on start and inspect reveals the occupying process

```console
$ procomp start orders
Error: [PORT_CONFLICT] Port conflict on 'orders' (port 18101): occupied by PID 10001 [python3 -m http.server 18101]. No processes were spawned and Routing Table was not modified. Run Inspection on 'orders' for details, or stop the Conflict Process with explicit consent. (service=orders, port=18101, pid=10001, commandLine=python3 -m http.server 18101, parentChain=9003:/bin/bash, healthEndpoint=http://127.0.0.1:18101/actuator/health, healthResponse=HTTP 404 (GET http://127.0.0.1:18101/actuator/health), outLogPath=/in-memory-state/procomp-e2e/logs/orders.out.log, errLogPath=/in-memory-state/procomp-e2e/logs/orders.err.log)
[exit 1]

$ procomp inspect orders
Service:         orders
Port:            18101
Desired Route:   REMOTE
Live Route:      OFFLINE
Owner:           CONFLICT (unknown)
Health:          STARTING
PID:             10001
Uptime:          5s
Stale:           no
RAM:             24 MB
Command Line:    python3 -m http.server 18101
Arguments:       -m http.server 18101
Parent Chain:
  - PID 9003: /bin/bash
Health Endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:18101/actuator/health
Health Response: HTTP 404 (GET http://127.0.0.1:18101/actuator/health)
Stdout Log:      /in-memory-state/procomp-e2e/logs/orders.out.log
Stderr Log:      /in-memory-state/procomp-e2e/logs/orders.err.log
Build Run:       NO_BUILDER
```

## Step 4: An Unmanaged Gateway is reused and reconciled, while gateway stop refuses to terminate it

```console
$ procomp gateway start
Gateway: reused UNMANAGED (shell) [PID 10002, HEALTHY] -> http://127.0.0.1:18080

$ procomp gateway reconcile
Gateway: reconciled 4 route mapping(s) on http://127.0.0.1:18080 (IN_SYNC)

$ procomp gateway status
Gateway:         wiremock (http://127.0.0.1:18080)
Port:            18080
Owner:           UNMANAGED (shell)
Health:          HEALTHY
PID:             10002
Uptime:          5s
Sync Status:     IN_SYNC
```
